regions.image_alt: Speed A port and Speed B port signal flow diagram, showing invalid/counting function, port type, logic direction, on delay, and off delay blocks.

regions.text: This parameter is used to switch the valid status of the input ports for controller speed A and speed B. This parameter must be set in the material full parameter group. Default is Const.
4.5.5 Speed A On/Off Delay and Speed B On/Off Delay

From applying a valid signal to speed A/B port to set speed active, this time period called on delay. From applying a invalid signal to speed A/B port to set speed inactive, this time period called off delay. For signal flow diagram, refer to Figure 4.5.4. The speed A&B on/off delay range is 0.0~99.9s, the default is 0.2s, and the adjustment accuracy is 0.1s.
